sentences.text: Health visitor Amina Hussain confirmed she would share information regarding children's safety if she was worried.
Leo is two years old and is saying approximately twenty words, including 'mama', 'car', 'more', 'bye-bye', and 'dog'.
Leo sometimes puts two words together, such as 'more juice'.
Leo is running and climbing everywhere; he climbed the bookcase last week.
Leo is fussy about eating, preferring toast, pasta, and yoghurt.
Poppy is fed via bottles about six times a day and has been started on baby rice.
Poppy has a bad nappy rash that is broken in places.
Jade Turner admitted she ran out of nappies on Sunday and had been leaving them on longer.
The nappy rash has been present for about a week.
Jade Turner stated she has not managed for food in the house, with only bread, some cereal, and one tin of Poppy's milk remaining until Friday.
Jade Turner's money comes in on Friday via Universal Credit.
Jade Turner described her financial situation as tight.
Jade Turner expressed that if she loses her job, she will be evicted because she cannot pay the rent.
Jade Turner stated she has not received any letters from the landlord or any notice.
Jade Turner expressed worry that the rent will not be paid.
Jade Turner started a cleaning job at a retail park in September working nights (10pm to 12am, sometimes half past midnight) on cash in hand.
Jade Turner stated that when her friend Shannon cannot look after Leo and Poppy, she has left them on their own for a couple of hours while they are asleep.
Jade Turner confirmed that Leo and Poppy are left alone in the flat for a couple of hours while she is at work.
Jade Turner stated this occurs roughly three nights a week since Shannon got her new job, which started the last month.
Jade Turner stated her mum is in Northby and would help, but they are not really talking.
Jade Turner agreed to ring her mum.
Jade Turner stated she did not know that Leo, who is two, could have fifteen hours of funded nursery.
Jade Turner agreed that Little Acorns on Marlow Road has spaces from January.
Jade Turner agreed to ensure the children are not left alone tonight; if Shannon cannot have them, she will not go in.
Jade Turner agreed to text her supervisor to say she has no childcare.
Amina Hussain agreed to make a referral to children's social care today.
Amina Hussain agreed to drop a food bank voucher round that afternoon before three.
Amina Hussain agreed to book Poppy in with Dr Lowe for the nappy rash tomorrow.
Amina Hussain agreed to bring nappies when she comes back.
Amina Hussain agreed to come back on Monday the 30th at ten to see how everyone is doing and help with the nursery form.
